name: tdp-workspace
description: TDP Monorepo workspace for NLE Frontend and Backend

scripts.build: npm --prefix NLE run build && npm --prefix CRM run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix NLE run typecheck:all && npm --prefix CRM run type-check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix NLE run lint && npm --prefix CRM run lint
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix NLE install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix CRM install
